arguments.command:
cd .github/workflows && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('release.yml').read()
a=s.index('      - name: Move the major tag')
b=s.index('      - name: Create the draft release')
move=s[a:b]; draft=s[b:]
s=s[:a]+draft+'\n'+move.rstrip('\n')+'\n'
s=s.replace("The job checks the tag, moves the major tag (vN), and creates a draft GitHub\n# Release with the notes from the pull request.","The job checks the tag, creates a draft GitHub Release with the notes from the pull\n# request, and moves the major tag (vN).")
open('release.yml','w').write(s)
EOF
sed -n 1,10p release.yml; tail -30 release.yml
